description: ANCF3423 shell tire(s) dropped onto rigid ground. run-examples.sh asks which ANCF tire USD to load (default: superjeep_tire.usda). Each tire entry is independent — position and material are per tire; the mesh and its per-section thickness come from the asset (E null = the asset's baked orthotropic material). Global solver params apply to all tires; pcg-iters null = the tire asset's recommendation (10, the locked budget, for every baked tire). Contact stiffness defaults to the larger of the tire USD value and a drop-energy estimate for the contact-penetration target; explicit kn overrides it. Damping defaults to the USD. The implicit solver uses 6 substeps / 2 NR / 10 PCG.

shell-tires._material: Reference — the asset's baked orthotropic 3-section material (Polaris recipe)
shell-tires.name: reference

shell-tires._material: Soft tire — 50% stiffness, lower pressure, lighter compound
shell-tires.name: soft

shell-tires._material: Stiff race tire — high pressure, dense compound
shell-tires.name: race
